en.topic_title: Domestic worker union hits back over employer group’s pay freeze petition

zh.topic_title: Domestic worker union hits back over employer group’s pay freeze petition

en.topic_title: Domestic worker union hits back over employer group’s pay freeze petition
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong migrant domestic worker union has rebuked calls by employer groups for a pay freeze as it called for stronger protections. It said recent wage increases have failed to catch up with the rising cost of living.



A foreign domestic worker at a training centre. File photo: Robert Godden.
